* Destiny 0 is rule-derived for all locations, not a printed destiny box. Locations have no deploy cost; no numerical deploy stat is supplied.<ref>[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary (1998)]], page 84; [[:File:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Advanced Rulebook (2023)]], pages 83–84.</ref>
* The final Decipher supplement says escaping Dark starfighters also draw movement destiny using the Light Side game text. This edition-labelled cross-reference does not establish a new 2017 gameplay change.<ref>[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Final Decipher Glossary Supplement]], updated January 29, 2002, pages 11, 15–16; current comparison [[:File:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Advanced Rulebook (2023)]], page 158.</ref>
